steps.content: That's a dead end.
After tracking through the maze-like slums for most of the day, she has finally cornered the woman in a dead end.
The dark shadow quietly slows her pace at the entrance.
Peering into the alley, she sees the woman at the dead end, standing frozen in place. There appears to be no struggle left in her.
Concealed in the shadows between buildings, she silently approaches her target. When just two meters away, she pounces like a leopard, driving her blade toward the chest of the cloaked woman.
But her blade meets no resistance—none of the jarring halt of flesh or the gritty catch of bone.
Sensing something is wrong, the shadow yanks the cloak away, only to discover nothing beneath. Its owner has long since vanished without a trace.
(Scene Change: Inside Parfait's room)
Sibilla presses her hands firmly against her mouth, terrified that even the slightest sound might alert the assassin lurking outside the window.
[Intensify horror atmosphere]
Sibilla hears a chilling, sinister laugh.

steps.speaker: Fraser Assassin
steps.content: Heh... Heheh... Good, keep running... Scuttle and hide like the filthy little pest you are...

steps.speaker: Fraser Assassin
steps.content: Shut your mouth and I might let you live a little longer...

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: ...Mmph...

She doesn't dare move—not an inch. Humiliation and rage sear through her, but it's the terror that chokes her, thick as a hand around her throat. Having lost too much blood, her consciousness begins to fray.

The ringing in her ears swallows the world. Every instinct screams at her to rush outside, to hurl herself onto the blade and end it all—No! She claws at the last frayed thread of reason not yet warped by terror. Think. Now.
What options does she have left? Is there anything in this room she can use against that assassin? What could possibly help her survive?!
(Red Flash)
The footsteps draw nearer—closer, louder—until Sibilla sees it. A long, distorted shadow spilling across the window frame, stretching toward her in the cold moonlight.
(Red Flash)

Then, she sees a high heel and a slender leg step through the window frame. Next emerges a suit, its fabric rippling like deep violet in the moonlight, and finally, a cascade of meticulously styled blonde hair...

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: Phew... Finally gone... What gang was that anyway? Prowling around my place...

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: Ugh, there's nothing even worth stealing—OW, MY HAIR MY HAIR! It's stuck—
The woman mutters under her breath about her stuck hair as she raises her head. In the moonlight, she finally spots the intruder inside the room.
After a brief silence, both women simultaneously erupt into ear-splitting screams.
(Red flash + screen shake + sound effect, maximum intensity)

steps.speaker: Parfait & Sibilla
steps.content: AAARRRRRRGGGHHH!!!!
